diff --git a/tests/test_websockets.py b/tests/test_websockets.py
index e76d8f2..d942105 100644
--- a/tests/test_websockets.py
+++ b/tests/test_websockets.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 import sys
-from collections.abc import MutableMapping
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, MutableMapping
+from pathlib import Path
 from typing import Any
 
 import anyio
@@ -7,7 +8,8 @@ import pytest
 from anyio.abc import ObjectReceiveStream, ObjectSendStream
 
 from starlette import status
-from starlette.responses import Response
+from starlette.background import BackgroundTask
+from starlette.responses import FileResponse, Response, StreamingResponse
 from starlette.testclient import WebSocketDenialResponse
 from starlette.types import Message, Receive, Scope, Send
 from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketState
@@ -322,6 +324,93 @@ def test_send_denial_response(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
     assert exc.value.content == b"foo"
 
 
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_send_denial_streaming_response() -> None:
+    background_calls = 0
+    messages: list[Message] = []
+
+    async def stream() -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+        yield "foo"
+        yield "bar"
+
+    async def background() -> None:
+        nonlocal background_calls
+        background_calls += 1
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:  # type: ignore[empty-body]
+        ...  # pragma: no cover
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        messages.append(message)
+
+    scope: Scope = {
+        "type": "websocket",
+        "headers": [],
+        "extensions": {"websocket.http.response": {}},
+        "asgi": {"spec_version": "2.4"},
+    }
+    websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+    response = StreamingResponse(stream(), status_code=404, background=BackgroundTask(background))
+    await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    assert [message["type"] for message in messages] == [
+        "websocket.http.response.start",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+    ]
+    assert messages[0]["status"] == 404
+    assert b"".join(message["body"] for message in messages[1:]) == b"foobar"
+    assert messages[-1]["more_body"] is False
+    assert background_calls == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_send_denial_file_response(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "denied.txt"
+    content = b"file denial"
+    path.write_bytes(content)
+    messages: list[Message] = []
+
+    class AsyncFile:
+        async def __aenter__(self) -> "AsyncFile":
+            return self
+
+        async def __aexit__(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+            pass
+
+        async def read(self, size: int) -> bytes:
+            return content
+
+    async def open_file(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> AsyncFile:
+        return AsyncFile()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(anyio, "open_file", open_file)
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:  # type: ignore[empty-body]
+        ...  # pragma: no cover
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        messages.append(message)
+
+    scope: Scope = {
+        "type": "websocket",
+        "headers": [],
+        "extensions": {"websocket.http.response": {}, "http.response.pathsend": {}},
+    }
+    websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+    response = FileResponse(path, status_code=403, stat_result=path.stat())
+    await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    assert [message["type"] for message in messages] == [
+        "websocket.http.response.start",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+    ]
+    assert messages[0]["status"] == 403
+    assert messages[1]["body"] == content
+    assert messages[1]["more_body"] is False
+
+
 def test_send_response_multi(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
     async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
         websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
